Inductive qstp : tenv -> senv -> qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| qs_sq : forall Γ Σ d1 d2,
    d1 ⊑↑ d2 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) d2↑ ->

    ♦∉ df ->

| qs_self_all : forall Γ Σ f df T1 d1 T2 d2,
    indexr f Γ = Some ((bind_tm, true, (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2), df)) ->

    ♦∉ df ->

| qs_qvar : forall Γ Σ b U x q1,
    indexr x Γ = Some((bind_tm, b, U, q1)) ->

| qs_cong : forall Γ Σ q d1 d2,
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->

    qstp Γ Σ (q ⊔ d1) (q ⊔ d2)

| qs_trans : forall Γ Σ d1 d2 d3,
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 -> qstp Γ Σ d2 d3 -> qstp Γ Σ d1 d3
.

Inductive stp : tenv -> senv -> ty -> qual -> ty -> qual -> Prop :=
| s_top : forall Γ Σ T d1 d2,
    closed_ty 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) T ->
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ T d1 TTop d2

| s_tvar_refl: forall Γ Σ x d1 d2 v,
    indexr x Γ = Some v ->
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ (TVar (varF x)) d1 (TVar (varF x)) d2

| s_tvar_trans: forall Γ Σ T1 T2 d0 d1 d2 x,
    indexr x Γ = Some((bind_ty, false, T1, d0)) ->
    closed_ty  0 0 (‖ Σ ‖) T1 ->
    stp Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ (TVar (varF x)) d1 T2 d2

| s_all: forall Γ Σ T1 T2 T3 T4 d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6,
    closed_ty 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) ->

    stp Γ Σ T3 d3 T1 d1  ->
    stp ((bind_ty, false, T3, d3) :: (bind_tm, true, TAll d1 d2 T1 T2, {♦}) :: Γ) Σ (open_ty' Γ T2) (openq' Γ d2) (open_ty' Γ T4) (openq' Γ d4) ->
    stp Γ Σ (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) d5 (TAll d3 d4 T3 T4) d6

| s_base : forall Γ Σ d1 d2,
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ TUnit d1 TUnit d2

| s_ref : forall Γ Σ T1 T2 q1 q2 d1 d2,
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ T1 ∅ T2 ∅ ->
    stp Γ Σ T2 ∅ T1 ∅ ->
    qstp Γ Σ q1 q2 ->
    qstp Γ Σ q2 q1 ->
    stp Γ Σ (TRef q1 T1) d1 (TRef q2 T2) d2

| s_fun : forall Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 T3 d3 T4 d4 d5 d6,

Definition not_free (v : id) (T : ty): Prop := [[ v ~> TUnit ~ ∅ ]]ᵀ T = T.

Fixpoint local_locs (t: tm) : qual :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t  => local_locs t
  | ttapp t  => local_locs t
  | tabs  t  => local_locs t
  | tapp t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | tref  t  => local_locs t
  | trefat t1 t2 => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | tderef t  => local_locs t
  | tassign t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | twithr t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | twithc l t => &!l ⊔ (local_locs t)
  | _ => ∅
  end.

Inductive has_type : tenv -> qual -> senv -> tm -> ty -> qual -> Prop :=
| t_tabs: forall Γ φ Σ t T1 T2 df d1 d2,
    closed_tm 2 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) t ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    d1 ⊑↑ df ⊔ {♦} ->
    df ⊑↑ φ ->
    ♦∉ df ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) df ->
    has_type ((bind_ty, false, T1, d1)  :: (bind_tm, true, (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2), df) :: Γ)
             (df ⊔ ($!‖Γ‖) ⊔ $!(S (‖Γ‖))) Σ (t <~²ᵗ Γ) (T2 <~²ᵀ Γ) (d2 <~²ᵈ Γ) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (ttabs t) (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) df

| t_tapp: forall Γ φ Σ t T1 T2 d1 d2 df,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) df ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T1 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) d1↑ ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    d1 ⊑↑ φ ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) d1 ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (ttapp t) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_tapp_fresh : forall Γ φ Σ t d1 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t (TAll (q_trans_tenv Γ df ⋒ q_trans_tenv Γ d1) d2 T1 T2) df ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T1 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) d1↑ ->
    d1 ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (♦∈ d1 -> not_free 1 T2) ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) d1 ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) (d2) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) ((q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df)) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (ttapp t) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_base : forall Γ Σ φ,
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ tunit TUnit ∅

| t_var : forall Γ φ Σ x b T d,
    indexr x Γ = Some ((bind_tm, b,T,d)) ->
    $!x ⊑↑ φ ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    closed_ty   0 x (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 x (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ $x T $!x

| t_abs: forall Γ φ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 df t,
    closed_tm   2 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) t ->
    closed_ty   0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    d1 ⊑↑ df ⊔ {♦} ->
    df ⊑↑ φ ->
    ♦∉ df ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) df ->
    has_type ((bind_tm, false, T1, d1) :: (bind_tm, true, (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2), df) :: Γ)
             (df ⊔ ($!‖Γ‖) ⊔ $!(S (‖Γ‖))) Σ (t <~²ᵗ Γ) (T2 <~²ᵀ Γ) (d2 <~²ᵈ Γ) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tabs t) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) df

| t_app : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 d1 t2 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) df ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T1 d1 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (df) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1 ⊔ local_locs t2) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tapp t1 t2) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_app_fresh : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 d1 t2 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TFun (q_trans_tenv Γ df ⋒ q_trans_tenv Γ d1) d2 T1 T2) df ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T1 d1 ->
    (♦∈ d1 -> not_free 1 T2) ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->

    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (df) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1 ⊔ local_locs t2) (d2) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1) ((q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df)) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tapp t1 t2) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_loc : forall Γ φ Σ l o T q,
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    sindexr l o Σ = Some (T,q) ->
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
    &!l ⊑↑ φ ->
    ♦∉ q ->

    has_type Γ φ Σ &(l,o) (TRef q T) (&!l)

| t_ref: forall Γ φ Σ T t d1,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t T d1 ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tref t) (TRef d1 T) ({♦})

| t_refat : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 t2 T d T1 d1 d2,
    has_type Γ φd Σ t1 T d ->
    ♦∉ d ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (t2) (TRef d1 T1) (d2) ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t2)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (trefat t1 t2) (TRef (d) T) (d2)

| t_deref: forall Γ φ Σ T d d1 t,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t (TRef d1 T) d ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    d1 ⊑↑ φ ->





    kill_sep (local_locs t) d1 ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ !t T d1

| t_assign: forall Γ φ φd Σ T t1 d d1 t2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TRef d1 T) d ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T d1 ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (d) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tassign t1 t2) TUnit ∅

| t_sub: forall Γ φ Σ e T1 d1 T2 d2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ e T1 d1 ->
    stp Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 ->
    d2 ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs e) d2 ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ e T2 d2

| t_withr : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 t2 T1 d1 T2 d2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 T1 d1 ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->



    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T2 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) d2↑ ->
    closed_tm 2 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) t2 ->
    has_type ((bind_tm, false, TRef d1 T1, {♦}) :: (bind_tm, true, TUnit, {♦}) :: Γ)
      (φd ⊔ $!(S (‖Γ‖))) Σ (t2 <~²ᵗ Γ) (T2) (d2) ->
    φd ⊑↑ φ ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1) φd ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (twithr t1 t2) T2 d2


| t_withc : forall Γ φ Σ l t T d,
    l < ‖Σ‖ ->
    has_type Γ (φ) Σ t T d ->
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
    kill_sep &!l d ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (twithc l t) T d

Inductive value : tm -> Prop :=
| value_ttabs: forall t, value (ttabs t)
| value_abs : forall t, value (tabs t)
| value_cst : value tunit
| value_loc : forall l o, value &(l, o)
.

Definition store := list (option (list (tm))).

Inductive step : tm -> store -> tm -> store -> Prop :=

| step_ttapp: forall t σ,
  step (ttapp (ttabs t)) σ (t <~ᵗ (ttabs t); tunit) σ
| step_beta : forall t v σ,
    value v ->
    step (tapp (tabs t) v) σ (t <~ᵗ (tabs t); v) σ
| step_ref : forall v σ,
    value v ->
    step (tref v) σ (&‖σ‖) ((Some [v]) :: σ)
| step_refat: forall v l o s σ,
    value v ->
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->

    step (trefat v &(l, o)) σ &(l, ‖s‖) (cinsert σ l (v))
| step_deref : forall σ l o s v,
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->
    indexr o s = Some (v) ->
    step (! &(l, o)) σ v σ
| step_assign : forall σ l o v s,
    l < ‖σ‖ ->
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->
    o < ‖s‖ ->
    value v ->
    step (tassign &(l, o) v) σ tunit (supdate σ l o v)
| step_twithr : forall σ v t,
    value v ->
    step (twithr v t) σ (twithc (‖σ‖) (t <~ᵗ tunit; (&‖σ‖))) ((Some [v]) :: σ)
| step_twithc : forall σ v l,
    value v ->
    step (twithc l v) σ v (update σ l None)

| step_c_tapp: forall t t' σ σ',
  step t σ t' σ' ->
  step (ttapp t)  σ (ttapp t') σ'
| step_c_ref : forall t t' σ σ',
    step t σ t' σ' ->
    step (tref t) σ (tref t') σ'
| step_c_refat_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    value t2 ->
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (trefat t1 t2) σ (trefat t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_refat_r : forall t1 t2 t2' σ σ',
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (trefat t1 t2) σ (trefat t1 t2') σ'
| step_c_deref : forall t t' σ σ',
    step t σ t' σ' ->
    step !t σ !t' σ'
| step_c_app_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (tapp t1 t2) σ (tapp t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_app_r : forall v t2 t2' σ σ',
    value v ->
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (tapp v t2) σ (tapp v t2') σ'
| step_c_assign_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (tassign t1 t2) σ (tassign t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_assign_r : forall v t2 t2' σ σ',
    value v ->
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (tassign v t2) σ (tassign v t2') σ'
| step_c_twithr_l : forall t1 t2 t1' σ σ',
  step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
  step (twithr t1 t2) σ (twithr t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_twithc : forall l t t' σ σ',
  step t σ t' σ' ->
  step (twithc l t) σ (twithc l t') σ'
.

Definition relation (X : Type)(Y: Type) := X -> Y -> X ->  Y -> Prop.

Definition deterministic {X : Type}{Y: Type} (R : relation X Y) :=
  forall (x x1 x2 : X) (y y1 y2: Y), R x y x1 y1 -> R x y x2 y2 -> x1 = x2 /\ y1 = y2.

Local Open Scope splicing.

Local Open Scope substitutions.

Inductive Substq : tenv -> senv -> qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| SExact : forall Γ Σ df,    ♦∉ df -> Substq Γ Σ df df
| SGrow  : forall Γ Σ df dx,
    ♦∉ dx ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) df ↑ ->
    Substq Γ Σ (q_trans_tenv Γ df ⋒ q_trans_tenv Γ dx) dx
.

Definition tph := tunit.

Definition root' (c : option (list tm)) : (option tm) :=
  match c with
  | None => None
  | Some (s) => match indexr 0 s with
                | None => Some tph
                | Some x => Some x
                end
  end.

Definition squish' (σ : store) : list (option tm) := map (root') σ.

Definition indexr' {X : Type} (n : nat) (l : option (list X)) : option X :=
  match l with
    | None => None
    | Some c => indexr n c
  end.

Fixpoint sindexr' {X : Type} (l : loc) (o : offset) (σ : list (option (list X))) : option X :=
  match σ with
    | [] => None
    | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then indexr' o a else sindexr' l o σ'
  end.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Compare_dec.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import vars.

Require Import env.

Require Import nats.

Require Import qualifiers.

Require Import boolean.

Import QualNotations.

Local Open Scope qualifiers.

Inductive ty : Type :=
| TTop  : ty
| TVar  : var -> ty
| TAll  : qual -> qual -> ty ->  ty -> ty
| TUnit : ty
| TFun  : qual -> qual -> ty -> ty -> ty
| TRef  : qual -> ty -> ty
.

Inductive tm : Type :=
| ttabs   :   tm -> tm
| ttapp   : tm ->   tm
| tunit   : tm
| tvar    : var -> tm
| tabs    : tm  -> tm
| tapp    : tm  -> tm -> tm
| tloc    : loc -> offset -> tm
| tref    : tm  -> tm
| tderef  : tm  -> tm
| tassign : tm  -> tm -> tm
| trefat  : tm  -> tm -> tm
| twithr  : tm  -> tm -> tm
| twithc  : loc -> tm -> tm
.

Notation "& ( l , o )" := (tloc l o) (at level 0, right associativity).

Notation "& l"   := (tloc l 0) (at level 0, right associativity).

Notation "! t"   := (tderef t) (at level 0, right associativity).

Coercion tvar : var >-> tm.

Coercion TVar : var >-> ty.

Inductive binding :=
| bind_tm : binding
| bind_ty : binding
.

Definition extends {A} (l1 l2 : list A): Prop := exists l', l1 = l' ++ l2.

Notation "x ⊇ y" := (extends x y) (at level 75).

Notation "‖ x ‖" := (length x) (at level 10).

Fixpoint open_rec_tm (k : nat) (u : tm) (t : tm) {struct t} : tm :=
  match t with
  | ttabs   t => ttabs   (open_rec_tm (S (S k)) u t)
  | ttapp t   => ttapp (open_rec_tm k u t)
  | tunit            => tunit
  | tvar   (varF x) => tvar (varF x)
  | tvar   (varB x) => if Nat.eqb k x then u else tvar (varB x)
  | tabs    t       => tabs    (open_rec_tm (S (S k)) u t)
  | tapp    t1 t2   => tapp    (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm k u t2)
  | tloc l o        => tloc l o
  | tref    t       => tref    (open_rec_tm k u t)
  | trefat t1 t2    => trefat (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm k u t2)
  | tderef  t       => tderef  (open_rec_tm k u t)
  | tassign t1 t2   => tassign (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm k u t2)
  | twithr t1 t2    => twithr (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm (S (S k)) u t2)
  | twithc l t      => twithc l (open_rec_tm k u t)
  end
.

Definition open_tm (u u' t : tm) := open_rec_tm 1 u' (open_rec_tm 0 u t).

Definition open_tm' {A : Type} (env : list A) t := open_rec_tm 1 $(S (‖ env ‖)) (open_rec_tm 0 ($‖env‖) t).

Definition openq (u u' q : qual) : qual := open_qual 1 u' (open_qual 0 u q).

Definition openq' {A} (env : list A) q  := openq ($!‖env‖) $!(S (‖env‖)) q.

Fixpoint open_rec_ty (k : nat)(U:  ty) (d' : qual) (T : ty) : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop              => TTop
  | TVar (varF x)     => TVar (varF x)
  | TVar (varB x)     => if Nat.eqb k x then U else (TVar (varB x))
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2  => TAll (open_qual k d' d1) (open_qual (S (S k)) d' d2) (open_rec_ty k U d' T1) (open_rec_ty (S (S k)) U d' T2)
  | TUnit             => TUnit
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2  => TFun (open_qual k d' d1) (open_qual (S (S k)) d' d2) (open_rec_ty k U d' T1) (open_rec_ty (S (S k)) U d' T2)
  | TRef d T          => TRef (open_qual k d' d) (open_rec_ty k U d' T)
  end.

Definition open_ty (U : ty)(du : qual)(V : ty)(dv : qual) (T : ty) : ty := (open_rec_ty 1 V dv  (open_rec_ty 0 U du T)).

Definition open_ty' {A : Type} (env : list A) (T : ty) :=
  open_ty  (TVar $(‖env‖)) ($!‖env‖) (TVar $(S (‖env‖))) ($!( S (‖env‖))) T.

Module OpeningNotations.

Declare Scope opening.

Notation "[[ k ~> u ]]ᵗ t"       := (open_rec_tm k u t) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "[[ k ~> U ~ d ]]ᵀ T"   := (open_rec_ty k U d T) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "[[ k ~> q' ]]ᵈ q"      := (open_qual k q' q) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "t <~ᵗ q ; q'"          := (open_tm q q' t) (at level 10, q at next level) : opening.

Notation "T <~ᵀ U ~ du ; V ~ dv" := (open_ty U du V dv  T) (at level 10, U, du at next level) : opening.

Notation "q <~ᵈ q' ; q''"        := (openq q' q'' q) (at level 10, q' at next level) : opening.

Notation "t <~²ᵗ g"              := (open_tm' g t) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "T <~²ᵀ g"              := (open_ty' g T) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "q <~²ᵈ g"              := (openq' g q) (at level 10) : opening.

End OpeningNotations.

Import OpeningNotations.

Local Open Scope opening.

Fixpoint ty_size (T : ty) : nat :=
  match T with
  | TTop            => 0
  | TVar _          => 0
  | TAll _ _ T1 T2  => S (ty_size T1 + ty_size T2)
  | TUnit           => 0
  | TFun  _ _ T1 T2 => S (ty_size T1 + ty_size T2)
  | TRef  _ T       => S (ty_size T)
  end.

Fixpoint splice (n : nat) (t : tm) {struct t} : tm :=
  match t with
  | ttabs   t  => ttabs (splice n t)
  | ttapp t    => ttapp (splice n t)
  | tunit          => tunit
  | tvar (varF i)  =>
    if le_lt_dec n i then tvar (varF (S i))
    else tvar (varF i)
  | tvar (varB i)  => tvar    (varB i)
  | tabs    t      => tabs    (splice n t)
  | tapp    t1 t2  => tapp    (splice n t1) (splice n t2)
  | tloc l o       => tloc    l o
  | tref    t      => tref    (splice n t)
  | trefat t1 t2   => trefat (splice n t1) (splice n t2)
  | tderef  t      => tderef  (splice n t)
  | tassign t1 t2  => tassign (splice n t1) (splice n t2)
  | twithr t1 t2   => twithr (splice n t1) (splice n t2)
  | twithc l t     => twithc l (splice n t)
  end.

Fixpoint splice_ty (n : nat) (T : ty) {struct T} : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop             => TTop
  | TVar (varF i)    => if le_lt_dec n i then TVar (varF (S i)) else TVar (varF i)
  | TVar (varB i)    => TVar (varB i)
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => TAll (splice_qual n d1) (splice_qual n d2) (splice_ty n T1) (splice_ty n T2)
  | TUnit            => TUnit
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => TFun (splice_qual n d1) (splice_qual n d2) (splice_ty n T1) (splice_ty n T2)
  | TRef d1 T        => TRef (splice_qual n d1) (splice_ty n T)
  end.

Fixpoint unsplice_ty (n : nat) (T : ty) {struct T} : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop             => TTop
  | TVar (varF i)    => if lt_dec n i then TVar (varF (Init.Nat.pred i)) else TVar (varF i)
  | TVar (varB i)    => TVar (varB i)
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => TAll (unsplice_qual n d1) (unsplice_qual n d2) (unsplice_ty n T1) (unsplice_ty n T2)
  | TUnit            => TUnit
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => TFun (unsplice_qual n d1) (unsplice_qual n d2) (unsplice_ty n T1) (unsplice_ty n T2)
  | TRef d1 T        => TRef (unsplice_qual n d1) (unsplice_ty n T)
  end.

Inductive closed_tm: nat  -> nat  -> nat  -> tm -> Prop :=
| cl_ttabs: forall b f l t,
  closed_tm (S (S b)) f l t ->
  closed_tm b f l (ttabs t)
| cl_ttapp: forall b f l t,
  closed_tm b f l t ->
  closed_tm b f l (ttapp t)
| cl_tsct : forall b f l,
    closed_tm b f l tunit
| cl_tvarb: forall b f l x,
    x < b ->
    closed_tm b f l #x
| cl_tvarf: forall b f l x,
    x < f ->
    closed_tm b f l $x
| cl_tabs:  forall b f l tm,
    closed_tm (S (S b)) f l tm ->
    closed_tm b f l (tabs tm)
| cl_tapp:  forall b f l tm1 tm2,
    closed_tm b f l tm1 ->
    closed_tm b f l tm2 ->
    closed_tm b f l (tapp tm1 tm2)
| cl_tloc: forall b f l l' o',
    l' < l ->
    closed_tm b f l &(l', o')
| cl_tref:  forall b f l tm,
    closed_tm b f l tm ->
    closed_tm b f l (tref tm)
| cl_trefat: forall b f l tm1 tm2,
    closed_tm b f l tm1 ->
    closed_tm b f l tm2 ->
    closed_tm b f l (trefat tm1 tm2)
| cl_tderef:  forall b f l tm,
    closed_tm b f l tm ->
    closed_tm b f l (tderef tm)
| cl_tassign:  forall b f l tm1 tm2,
    closed_tm b f l tm1 ->
    closed_tm b f l tm2 ->
    closed_tm b f l (tassign tm1 tm2)
| cl_twithr: forall b f l tm1 tm2,
    closed_tm b f l tm1 ->
    closed_tm (S (S b)) f l tm2 ->
    closed_tm b f l (twithr tm1 tm2)
| cl_twithc: forall b f l l' t,
    l' < l ->
    closed_tm b f l t ->
    closed_tm b f l (twithc l' t)
.

Inductive closed_ty : nat  -> nat  -> nat  -> ty -> Prop :=
| cl_TTop : forall b f l,
  closed_ty b  f l TTop
| cl_ttvarf: forall b f l x,
  x < f ->
  closed_ty b f l (TVar (varF x))
| cl_ttvarb: forall b f l x,
  x < b ->
  closed_ty b f l (TVar (varB x))
|  cl_TAll:  forall b f l d1 d2 T1 T2 ,
  closed_Qual b f l d1 ↑ ->
  closed_Qual  (S (S b)) f l d2 ↑ ->
  closed_ty b f l T1 ->
  closed_ty (S (S b)) f l T2 ->
  closed_ty b f l (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2)
| cl_TUnit : forall b f l,
    closed_ty b f l TUnit
| cl_TRef : forall b f l T q,
    closed_ty b f l T ->
    closed_Qual b f l q ↑ ->
    closed_ty b f l (TRef q T)
| cl_TFun : forall b f l d1 d2 T1 T2,
    closed_Qual b f l d1 ↑ ->
    closed_Qual (S (S b)) f l d2 ↑ ->
    closed_ty b f l T1 ->
    closed_ty (S (S b)) f l T2 ->
    closed_ty b f l (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint tfvs (T : ty) (n : nat) {struct T} : bool :=
  match T with
  | TVar (varF i)    => i =? n
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => qfvs d1 n || qfvs d2 n || tfvs T1 n || tfvs T2 n
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => qfvs d1 n || qfvs d2 n || tfvs T1 n || tfvs T2 n
  | TRef d1 T        => qfvs d1 n || tfvs T n
  | _                => false
  end.

Fixpoint Tfvs (T : ty) (n : nat) {struct T} : Prop :=
  match T with
  | TVar (varF i)    => i = n
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => qfvs d1↑ n \/ qfvs d2↑ n \/ Tfvs T1 n \/ Tfvs T2 n
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => qfvs d1↑ n \/ qfvs d2↑ n \/ Tfvs T1 n \/ Tfvs T2 n
  | TRef d1 T        => qfvs d1↑ n \/ Tfvs T n
  | _                => False
  end.

Fixpoint tbvs (T : ty) (n : nat) {struct T} : bool :=
  match T with
  | TVar (varF i)    => i =? n
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => qbvs d1 n || qbvs d2 (S (S n)) || tbvs T1 n || tbvs T2 (S (S n))
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => qbvs d1 n || qbvs d2 (S (S n)) || tbvs T1 n || tbvs T2 (S (S n))
  | TRef d1 T        => qbvs d1 n || tbvs T n
  | _                => false
  end.

Fixpoint Tbvs (T : ty) (n : nat) {struct T} : Prop :=
  match T with
  | TVar (varF i)    => i = n
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => qbvs d1↑ n \/ qbvs d2↑ (S (S n)) \/ Tbvs T1 n \/ Tbvs T2 (S (S n))
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => qbvs d1↑ n \/ qbvs d2↑ (S (S n)) \/ Tbvs T1 n \/ Tbvs T2 (S (S n))
  | TRef d1 T        => qbvs d1↑ n \/ Tbvs T n
  | _                => False
  end.

Inductive disjointq (Σ Σ' : senv) : qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| disj_bot : forall q,
    disjointq Σ Σ' q ∅
| disj_loc : forall T q q',
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
    ♦∉ q ->
    Σ' = [(T,q)] :: Σ ->
    disjointq Σ Σ' q' (&!‖Σ‖)
.

Notation " S → T ∋ q ⊕ q'" := (disjointq S T q q') (at level 10).

Definition CtxOK (Γ : tenv) (φ : qual) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (σ : store) : Prop :=
  qdom' σ ⊑↑ qdom Σ /\ ‖ σ ‖ = ‖ Σ ‖ /\
     φ ⊑↑ (qdom Σ) /\
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) ϰ↑ /\
  kill_sep ϰ φ /\
  forall l o cty T q,
  (l ∈ₗ ϰ -> indexr l σ = Some None) /\ (~(l∈ₗ ϰ) ->
    l ∈ₗ φ ->
    indexr l Σ = Some cty ->
    (exists ctm, (indexr l σ = Some (Some ctm) /\ (‖ cty ‖) = (‖ ctm ‖)) /\
    (indexr o cty = Some (T,q) ->  (exists v, indexr o ctm = Some v /\
      value v /\ (q ⊑↑ φ -> vtp Σ ϰ φ v T q))))

  )
.

Fixpoint wf_step (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t1 => local_locs t1 = ∅
  | ttapp t1 => wf_step t1
  | tabs t1 => local_locs t1 = ∅
  | tapp t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ ((value t1) \/ local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | tref t1 => wf_step t1
  | trefat t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ (local_locs t1 = ∅ \/ (value t2))
  | tderef t1 => wf_step t1
  | tassign t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ ((value t1) \/ local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | twithr t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ (local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | twithc l t1 => wf_step t1
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition wf_store (σ : store) : Prop :=
    forall l o v, sindexr' l o σ = Some (v) -> wf_step v /\ value v.

Inductive envUpdate (Σ : senv) (φ : qual) (ϰ : qual) (LC : qual): senv -> qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| env_phi : forall Σ',

    Σ' ⊇₂ Σ ->
    ‖Σ'‖ = ‖Σ‖ ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ' φ ϰ
| env_fresh : forall T q,
    kill_sep ϰ q ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC ([(T,q)] :: Σ) (φ ⊔ &!(‖Σ‖)) ϰ
| env_kill : forall l,
    l < (‖Σ‖) ->
    l ∈ₗ LC ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ (q_remove Σ l φ) (ϰ ⊔ &!l)
.

Inductive preserve (Γ : tenv) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (φ : qual) (LC : qual) (t' : tm) (T : ty) (d : qual) (σ' : store) : Prop :=
| Preserve : forall Σ' d' φ' ϰ',
    Σ' ⊇₂ Σ ->

    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ' φ' ϰ' ->
    d' ⊑↑ φ' ->
    wf_senv Σ' ->
    CtxOK Γ φ' Σ' ϰ' σ' ->
    Σ → Σ' ∋ d ⊕ d'  ->
    has_type Γ φ' Σ' t' T (d ⋓ d') ->

    wf_store σ' ->
    wf_step t' ->
    preserve Γ Σ ϰ φ LC t' T d σ'.

Arguments Preserve {Γ Σ ϰ φ LC t' T d σ'}.

Theorem type_safety: forall {Σ ϰ t T d φ},
  has_type [] φ Σ t T d -> wf_senv Σ -> wf_step t -> (
    value t \/
    (forall {σ} , CtxOK [] φ Σ ϰ σ -> wf_store σ ->
      (exists t' σ',
        step t σ t' σ' /\ preserve [] Σ ϰ φ (local_locs t) t' T d σ'
      )
    )
  ).

Definition not_free (v : id) (T : ty): Prop := [[ v ~> TUnit ~ ∅ ]]ᵀ T = T.

Fixpoint local_locs (t: tm) : qual :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t  => local_locs t
  | ttapp t  => local_locs t
  | tabs  t  => local_locs t
  | tapp t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | tref  t  => local_locs t
  | trefat t1 t2 => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | tderef t  => local_locs t
  | tassign t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | twithr t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | twithc l t => &!l ⊔ (local_locs t)
  | _ => ∅
  end.

Inductive has_type : tenv -> qual -> senv -> tm -> ty -> qual -> Prop :=
| t_tabs: forall Γ φ Σ t T1 T2 df d1 d2,
    closed_tm 2 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) t ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    d1 ⊑↑ df ⊔ {♦} ->
    df ⊑↑ φ ->
    ♦∉ df ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) df ->
    has_type ((bind_ty, false, T1, d1)  :: (bind_tm, true, (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2), df) :: Γ)
             (df ⊔ ($!‖Γ‖) ⊔ $!(S (‖Γ‖))) Σ (t <~²ᵗ Γ) (T2 <~²ᵀ Γ) (d2 <~²ᵈ Γ) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (ttabs t) (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) df

| t_tapp: forall Γ φ Σ t T1 T2 d1 d2 df,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) df ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T1 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) d1↑ ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    d1 ⊑↑ φ ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) d1 ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (ttapp t) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_tapp_fresh : forall Γ φ Σ t d1 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t (TAll (q_trans_tenv Γ df ⋒ q_trans_tenv Γ d1) d2 T1 T2) df ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T1 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) d1↑ ->
    d1 ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (♦∈ d1 -> not_free 1 T2) ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) d1 ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) (d2) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) ((q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df)) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (ttapp t) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_base : forall Γ Σ φ,
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ tunit TUnit ∅

| t_var : forall Γ φ Σ x b T d,
    indexr x Γ = Some ((bind_tm, b,T,d)) ->
    $!x ⊑↑ φ ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    closed_ty   0 x (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 x (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ $x T $!x

| t_abs: forall Γ φ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 df t,
    closed_tm   2 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) t ->
    closed_ty   0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    d1 ⊑↑ df ⊔ {♦} ->
    df ⊑↑ φ ->
    ♦∉ df ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) df ->
    has_type ((bind_tm, false, T1, d1) :: (bind_tm, true, (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2), df) :: Γ)
             (df ⊔ ($!‖Γ‖) ⊔ $!(S (‖Γ‖))) Σ (t <~²ᵗ Γ) (T2 <~²ᵀ Γ) (d2 <~²ᵈ Γ) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tabs t) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) df

| t_app : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 d1 t2 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) df ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T1 d1 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (df) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1 ⊔ local_locs t2) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tapp t1 t2) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_app_fresh : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 d1 t2 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TFun (q_trans_tenv Γ df ⋒ q_trans_tenv Γ d1) d2 T1 T2) df ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T1 d1 ->
    (♦∈ d1 -> not_free 1 T2) ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->

Fixpoint update {A} (σ : list A) (l : nat) (v : A) : list A :=
  match σ with

Fixpoint insert {A} (σ : list A) (l : nat) (v : A) : list A :=

    | [] => None
    | a :: l' =>
      if (Nat.eqb n (length l')) then Some a else indexr n l'
  end.

Fixpoint delete_nth (n : nat) {A} (l : list A) : list A :=
  match l with
  | nil       => nil
  | cons x xs => if (Nat.eqb n (length xs)) then xs else x :: (delete_nth n xs)
  end.

Definition slength {A} (l : option (list A)) : nat :=
  match l with
  | None => 0
  | Some l' => length l'
  end.

Definition update' {A} (s : option (list A)) (o : nat) (v : A) : option (list A) :=
  match s with
  | None => None
  | Some c => Some (update c o v)
  end.

Fixpoint supdate {A} (σ : list (option (list (A)))) (l : loc) (o : offset) (v : A) : list (option (list (A))) :=
  match σ with
  | [] => σ
  | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then ( (update' a o v) :: σ') else (a :: (supdate σ' l o v ))
  end.

Definition insert' {A} (s : option (list A)) (v : A) : option (list A) :=
  match s with
  | None => None
  | Some c => Some (v :: c)
  end.

Fixpoint cinsert {A} (σ : list (option (list (A)))) (l : loc) (v : A) : list (option (list (A))) :=
  match σ with
  | [] => σ
  | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then
        insert' a v :: σ'
      else (a :: (cinsert σ' l v ))
  end.

Fixpoint sindexr {X : Type} (l : loc) (o : offset) (σ : list (list X)) : option X :=
  match σ with
    | [] => None
    | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then indexr o a else sindexr l o σ'
  end.

Fixpoint sinsert {A} (s : list ((list (A)))) (l : loc) (x : A) : list (list (A)) :=
  match s with
  | [] => s
  | c :: s' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length s')) then
        ((x :: c) :: s')
      else (c :: (sinsert s' l x ))
  end.

Definition nats := nat -> bool.

Definition n_empty: nats := fun x => false.

Definition n_one (x:nat): nats := fun x' => x' =? x.

Definition n_and q1 q2 (x:nat) := (q1 x) && q2 x.

Definition n_or q1 q2 (x:nat) := (q1 x) || q2 x.

Definition n_diff q1 q2 (x: nat) := (q1 x) && (negb (q2 x)).

Definition n_dom {X} (H: list X) := fun x' =>  x' <? (length H).

Definition n_dom' {X} (H: list (option X)) := fun x' => (x' <? length H) &&
  match indexr x' H with | Some (Some _) => true | _ => false end.

Definition n_sub (q1 q2: nats): Prop := forall x:nat, q1 x = true -> q2 x = true.

Definition n_splice (n: nat) (q: nats) : nats := fun x =>
         if x =? n then false else if x <? n then q x else q (pred x).

Definition n_unsplice (n: nat) (q: nats) : nats := fun x =>
         if x <? n then q x else q (S x).

Local Lemma safety_indexr_bound {A} (xs : list A) k x :
  indexr k xs = Some x -> k < length xs.
Proof.
  induction xs as [|a xs IH]; simpl; [discriminate|].
  destruct (k =? length xs) eqn:Heq.
  - apply Nat.eqb_eq in Heq. lia.
  - intros H. specialize (IH H). lia.

Local Lemma safety_indexr_exists {A} (xs : list A) k :
  k < length xs -> exists x, indexr k xs = Some x.

  destruct (k =? length xs) eqn:Heq.
  - eauto.

Require Import rules.

Require Import vtp_subst.

Import QualNotations.

Local Open Scope qualifiers.

Import OpeningNotations.

Local Open Scope opening.

Import SplicingNotations.

Local Open Scope splicing.

Import SubstitutionNotations.

Local Open Scope substitutions.

Inductive disjointq (Σ Σ' : senv) : qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| disj_bot : forall q,
    disjointq Σ Σ' q ∅
| disj_loc : forall T q q',
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
    ♦∉ q ->
    Σ' = [(T,q)] :: Σ ->
    disjointq Σ Σ' q' (&!‖Σ‖)
.

Arguments disj_loc { Σ Σ' }.

Notation " S → T ∋ q ⊕ q'" := (disjointq S T q q') (at level 10).

Definition CtxOK (Γ : tenv) (φ : qual) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (σ : store) : Prop :=
  qdom' σ ⊑↑ qdom Σ /\ ‖ σ ‖ = ‖ Σ ‖ /\
     φ ⊑↑ (qdom Σ) /\
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) ϰ↑ /\
  kill_sep ϰ φ /\
  forall l o cty T q,
  (l ∈ₗ ϰ -> indexr l σ = Some None) /\ (~(l∈ₗ ϰ) ->
    l ∈ₗ φ ->
    indexr l Σ = Some cty ->
    (exists ctm, (indexr l σ = Some (Some ctm) /\ (‖ cty ‖) = (‖ ctm ‖)) /\
    (indexr o cty = Some (T,q) ->  (exists v, indexr o ctm = Some v /\
      value v /\ (q ⊑↑ φ -> vtp Σ ϰ φ v T q))))

  )
.

Fixpoint wf_step (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t1 => local_locs t1 = ∅
  | ttapp t1 => wf_step t1
  | tabs t1 => local_locs t1 = ∅
  | tapp t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ ((value t1) \/ local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | tref t1 => wf_step t1
  | trefat t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ (local_locs t1 = ∅ \/ (value t2))
  | tderef t1 => wf_step t1
  | tassign t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ ((value t1) \/ local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | twithr t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ (local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | twithc l t1 => wf_step t1
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition wf_store (σ : store) : Prop :=
    forall l o v, sindexr' l o σ = Some (v) -> wf_step v /\ value v.

Inductive envUpdate (Σ : senv) (φ : qual) (ϰ : qual) (LC : qual): senv -> qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| env_phi : forall Σ',

    Σ' ⊇₂ Σ ->
    ‖Σ'‖ = ‖Σ‖ ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ' φ ϰ
| env_fresh : forall T q,
    kill_sep ϰ q ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC ([(T,q)] :: Σ) (φ ⊔ &!(‖Σ‖)) ϰ
| env_kill : forall l,
    l < (‖Σ‖) ->
    l ∈ₗ LC ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ (q_remove Σ l φ) (ϰ ⊔ &!l)
.

Inductive preserve (Γ : tenv) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (φ : qual) (LC : qual) (t' : tm) (T : ty) (d : qual) (σ' : store) : Prop :=
| Preserve : forall Σ' d' φ' ϰ',
    Σ' ⊇₂ Σ ->

    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ' φ' ϰ' ->
    d' ⊑↑ φ' ->
    wf_senv Σ' ->
    CtxOK Γ φ' Σ' ϰ' σ' ->
    Σ → Σ' ∋ d ⊕ d'  ->
    has_type Γ φ' Σ' t' T (d ⋓ d') ->

    wf_store σ' ->
    wf_step t' ->
    preserve Γ Σ ϰ φ LC t' T d σ'.

Arguments Preserve {Γ Σ ϰ φ LC t' T d σ'}.

Theorem type_safety: forall {Σ ϰ t T d φ},
  has_type [] φ Σ t T d -> wf_senv Σ -> wf_step t -> (
    value t \/
    (forall {σ} , CtxOK [] φ Σ ϰ σ -> wf_store σ ->
      (exists t' σ',
        step t σ t' σ' /\ preserve [] Σ ϰ φ (local_locs t) t' T d σ'
      )
    )
  ).
  end.

Class substitutable_env {p : Type} `{@qenv p}: Type := {

  env_subst : nat -> ty -> qual -> p -> p;
}.

Definition subst_tenv_elmt := (fun n T' q' (X : (binding * bool * ty * qual)) =>
  match X with
  | (bd, b, T, q) => (bd, b, subst_ty T n T' q', subst_qual q n q')
  end).

Definition subst_senv_elmt := (fun n T' q' (X : (ty * qual)) =>
  match X with
  | (T, q) => (subst_ty T n T' q', subst_qual q n q')
  end).

#[export] Instance tenv_substitutable : @substitutable_env (binding * bool * ty * qual) tenv_qenv := {
  env_subst := subst_tenv_elmt;
}.

#[export] Instance senv_substitutable : @substitutable_env (ty * qual) senv_qenv := {
  env_subst := subst_senv_elmt;
}.

Definition subst_env {p : Type} `{substitutable_env p} (n : nat) (T' : ty) (q' : qual)  (E : env p): env p := map (env_subst n T' q') E.

Definition subst_tenv (Γ : tenv) (v : nat) (U: ty)(q1 : qual) : tenv := subst_env v U q1 Γ.

Definition subst_senv (Σ : senv) (v : nat) (U: ty)(q1 : qual) : senv := map (subst_env v U q1) Σ.

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('Task.v')
s=p.read_text()
i=s.index('Theorem type_safety')
p.write_text(s[:i]+'''Local Lemma safety_no_scopes t :
  (forall l, ~ l ∈ₗ local_locs t) ->
  local_locs t = ∅ /\\\\ wf_step t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; intros H;
    try solve [split; [reflexivity|exact I]];
    try solve [apply IHt; exact H];
    try solve [destruct (IHt H) as [Heq _]; auto].
  all: try match goal with
  | HA : forall l, ~ l ∈ₗ (?a ⊔ ?b) |- _ =>
    let Hl := fresh \"Hl\" in let Hr := fresh \"Hr\" in
    assert (Hl : forall l, ~ l ∈ₗ a)
      by (intros l Hmem; apply (HA l); apply orb_true_iff; left; exact Hmem);
    assert (Hr : forall l, ~ l ∈ₗ b)
      by (intros l Hmem; apply (HA l); apply orb_true_iff; right; exact Hmem);
    destruct (IHt1 Hl) as [Hleft Wleft];
    destruct (IHt2 Hr) as [Hright Wright];
    rewrite Hleft, Hright; repeat split; try assumption; auto
  end.
  exfalso. apply (H l), orb_true_iff. left. apply Nat.eqb_refl.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_empty_scopes_wf t : local_locs t = ∅ -> wf_step t.
Proof.
  intro H. apply safety_no_scopes. rewrite H. discriminate.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_open_scopes t k u :
  local_locs u = ∅ -> local_locs ([[k ~> u]]ᵗ t) = local_locs t.
Proof.
  revert k. induction t; intros k Hu; simpl; try rewrite ?IHt, ?IHt1, ?IHt2 by assumption;
    try reflexivity.
  destruct v; simpl; [reflexivity|].
  destruct (k =? i); auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_value_scopes v :
  value v -> wf_step v -> local_locs v = ∅.
Proof. intros H; inversion H; simpl; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_sindexr_store {A} (ss : list (option (list A))) l o s :
  indexr l ss = Some (Some s) -> sindexr' l o ss = indexr o s.
Proof.
  induction ss as [|a ss IH]; simpl; [discriminate|].
  destruct (l =? length ss).
  - intros H. inversion H. reflexivity.
  - apply IH.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_indexr_update {A} (xs : list A) l k v :
  indexr k (update xs l v) =
    if k =? l then option_map (fun _ => v) (indexr k xs) else indexr k xs.
Proof.
  assert (Hlen : forall ys : list A, length (update ys l v) = length ys).
  { induction ys; simpl; auto. destruct (l =? length ys); simpl; congruence. }
  induction xs as [|a xs IH]; simpl.
  - destruct (k =? l); reflexivity.
  - destruct (l =? length xs) eqn:Hl; simpl.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hl. subst.
      destruct (k =? length xs); reflexivity.
    + rewrite Hlen. destruct (k =? length xs) eqn:Hk; [|exact IH].
      apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hk. subst. rewrite Nat.eqb_sym, Hl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_lookup_store {A} (ss : list (option (list A))) l o :
  sindexr' l o ss =
    match indexr l ss with Some s => indexr' o s | None => None end.
Proof.
  induction ss as [|a ss IH]; simpl; auto.
  destruct (l =? length ss); auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_update_store_wf σ l :
  wf_store σ -> wf_store (update σ l None).
Proof.
  intros Hs k o v H.
  rewrite safety_lookup_store, safety_indexr_update in H.
  destruct (k =? l).
  - destruct (indexr k σ); discriminate.
  - apply (Hs k o v). rewrite safety_lookup_store. exact H.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_cons_store_wf σ v :
  wf_step v -> value v -> wf_store σ -> wf_store (Some [v] :: σ).
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hval Hs l o w H.
  simpl in H. destruct (l =? length σ); [|eauto].
  simpl in H. destruct (o =? 0); inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_supdate_as_update {A} (ss : list (option (list A))) l o s v :
  indexr l ss = Some (Some s) ->
  supdate ss l o v = update ss l (Some (update s o v)).
Proof.

p.write_text(s[:i]+'''Local Lemma safety_senv_length Σ Σ' :
  Σ' ⊇₂ Σ -> length Σ <= length Σ'.
Proof.
  intros Hext.
  destruct Σ as [|c Σ]; [simpl; lia|].
  assert (Hlook : indexr (length Σ) (c :: Σ) = Some c)
    by (simpl; rewrite Nat.eqb_refl; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hext _ _ Hlook) as (c' & Hc' & _).
  pose proof (safety_indexr_bound _ _ _ Hc'). simpl. lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_indexr_prefix {A} (ys xs : list A) k x :
  indexr k xs = Some x -> indexr k (ys ++ xs) = Some x.
Proof.
  intros H. pose proof (safety_indexr_bound _ _ _ H).
  induction ys; simpl; auto.
  rewrite app_length.
  assert (k =? length ys + length xs = false)
    by (apply Nat.eqb_neq; lia).
  now rewrite H1.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_sindexr_intro {A} (ss : list (list A)) l o s x :
  indexr l ss = Some s -> indexr o s = Some x ->
  sindexr l o ss = Some x.
Proof.
  induction ss as [|a ss IH]; simpl; [discriminate|].
  destruct (l =? length ss) eqn:Hl.
  - intros H. inversion H; auto.
  - apply IH.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_sindexr_weaken Σ Σ' l o x :
  Σ' ⊇₂ Σ -> sindexr l o Σ = Some x -> sindexr l o Σ' = Some x.
Proof.
  intros Hext Hx.
  destruct (safety_sindexr _ _ _ _ Hx) as (c & Hc & Ho).
  destruct (Hext _ _ Hc) as (c' & Hc' & ys & ->).
  eapply safety_sindexr_intro; eauto using safety_indexr_prefix.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_locs_closed_weaken b f l l' q :
  l <= l' -> closed_Qual b f l q -> closed_Qual b f l' q.
Proof.
  intros Hle (Hf & Hb & Hl).
  split; [exact Hf|]. split; [exact Hb|].
  intros k Hk. specialize (Hl k Hk). lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_ty_closed_weaken b f l l' T :
  l <= l' -> closed_ty b f l T -> closed_ty b f l' T.
Proof.
  intros Hle H. induction H; constructor; eauto using safety_locs_closed_weaken.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_tm_closed_weaken b f l l' t :
  l <= l' -> closed_tm b f l t -> closed_tm b f l' t.
Proof.
  intros Hle H. induction H; constructor; try assumption; lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_qstp_weaken Γ Σ Σ' q d :
  Σ' ⊇₂ Σ -> qstp Γ Σ q d -> qstp Γ Σ' q d.
Proof.
  intros Hext H.
  pose proof (safety_senv_length _ _ Hext).
  induction H; eauto using qstp, safety_locs_closed_weaken, safety_ty_closed_weaken.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_stp_weaken Γ Σ Σ' T d U e :
  Σ' ⊇₂ Σ -> stp Γ Σ T d U e -> stp Γ Σ' T d U e.
Proof.
  intros Hext H.
  pose proof (safety_senv_length _ _ Hext).
  induction H; eauto using stp, safety_qstp_weaken, safety_ty_closed_weaken.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_typing_weaken Γ φ Σ Σ' t T d :
  Σ' ⊇₂ Σ -> has_type Γ φ Σ t T d -> has_type Γ φ Σ' t T d.
Proof.
  intros Hext H.
  pose proof (safety_senv_length _ _ Hext).
  induction H;
    eauto 12 using has_type, safety_locs_closed_weaken, safety_ty_closed_weaken,
      safety_tm_closed_weaken, safety_sindexr_weaken, safety_stp_weaken, Nat.lt_le_trans.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_vtp_weaken Σ Σ' ϰ φ v T d :
  Σ' ⊇₂ Σ -> vtp Σ ϰ φ v T d -> vtp Σ' ϰ φ v T d.
Proof.
  intros Hext H.
  pose proof (safety_senv_length _ _ Hext).
  induction H;
    eauto 12 using vtp, safety_locs_closed_weaken, safety_ty_closed_weaken,
      safety_tm_closed_weaken, safety_sindexr_weaken, safety_stp_weaken,
      safety_qstp_weaken, safety_typing_weaken.
Qed.

from pathlib import Path

p.write_text(s[:i]+'''Local Lemma safety_subq_refl a : a ⊑↑ a.
Proof. unfold Subq, N_sub. intuition. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_subq_trans a b c :
  a ⊑↑ b -> b ⊑↑ c -> a ⊑↑ c.
Proof. unfold Subq, N_sub. firstorder. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_qual_le a b :
  a ⊑↑ b <->
  (qfresh a = true -> qfresh b = true) /\\\\
  n_sub (qfvs a) (qfvs b) /\\\\
  n_sub (qbvs a) (qbvs b) /\\\\
  n_sub (qlocs a) (qlocs b).
Proof.
  unfold Subq, N_sub, n_sub, Q_lift, N_lift.
  cbn [qfresh qfvs qbvs qlocs fst snd].
  destruct (qfresh a), (qfresh b); simpl; tauto.
Qed.

Local Ltac safety_qpoint :=
  repeat rewrite safety_qual_le in *;
  unfold closed_Qual, closed_Nats, kill_sep in *;
  repeat rewrite safety_qual_le in *;
  unfold n_sub, qmem, Q_lift, N_lift, qor, qand, qdiff, q_empty,
    n_empty, n_one, n_diff, n_or, n_and in *;
  cbn [qfresh qfvs qbvs qlocs fst snd] in *;
  repeat first [rewrite andb_true_iff in * | rewrite orb_true_iff in *
               | rewrite negb_true_iff in * | rewrite Nat.eqb_eq in *];
  try firstorder congruence.

Local Lemma safety_join_l a b : a ⊑↑ a ⊔ b.
Proof. safety_qpoint. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_join_r a b : b ⊑↑ a ⊔ b.
Proof. safety_qpoint. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_join_bound a b c :
  a ⊑↑ c -> b ⊑↑ c -> a ⊔ b ⊑↑ c.
Proof. safety_qpoint. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_empty_bound a : ∅ ⊑↑ a.
Proof. safety_qpoint. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_join_fresh_dup a : (a ⊔ {♦}) ⊔ {♦} ⊑↑ a ⊔ {♦}.
Proof. safety_qpoint. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_diff_ambient φ ψ K :
  φ ⊑↑ ψ -> qdiff φ K ⊑↑ qdiff ψ K.
Proof. safety_qpoint. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_qual_closed_of_sub b f l a c :
  a ⊑↑ c -> closed_Qual b f l c↑ -> closed_Qual b f l a↑.
Proof. safety_qpoint. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_qual_join_closed b f l a c :
  closed_Qual b f l a↑ -> closed_Qual b f l c↑ ->
  closed_Qual b f l (a ⊔ c)↑.
Proof. safety_qpoint. Qed.

Local Lemma safety_qual_const_closed b f l fresh :
  closed_Qual b f l (∅{fresh})↑.

  destruct (Hv Ho) as (v & Hvo & Hval & Hvtp).

  - apply safety_empty_bound.
  - repeat (split; try assumption).
  - apply disj_bot.
  - assert (Hrφ : r ⊑↑ φ) by eauto using safety_subq_trans.
    pose proof (safety_vtp_typing _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvtp Hrφ (safety_dom_closed _ _ Hφ) Hwv) as Hty.

Definition not_free (v : id) (T : ty): Prop := [[ v ~> TUnit ~ ∅ ]]ᵀ T = T.

Fixpoint local_locs (t: tm) : qual :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t  => local_locs t
  | ttapp t  => local_locs t
  | tabs  t  => local_locs t
  | tapp t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | tref  t  => local_locs t
  | trefat t1 t2 => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | tderef t  => local_locs t
  | tassign t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | twithr t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | twithc l t => &!l ⊔ (local_locs t)
  | _ => ∅
  end.

    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ tunit TUnit ∅

| t_var : forall Γ φ Σ x b T d,
    indexr x Γ = Some ((bind_tm, b,T,d)) ->
    $!x ⊑↑ φ ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    closed_ty   0 x (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 x (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ $x T $!x

| t_abs: forall Γ φ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 df t,
    closed_tm   2 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) t ->
    closed_ty   0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    d1 ⊑↑ df ⊔ {♦} ->
    df ⊑↑ φ ->
    ♦∉ df ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) df ->
    has_type ((bind_tm, false, T1, d1) :: (bind_tm, true, (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2), df) :: Γ)
             (df ⊔ ($!‖Γ‖) ⊔ $!(S (‖Γ‖))) Σ (t <~²ᵗ Γ) (T2 <~²ᵀ Γ) (d2 <~²ᵈ Γ) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tabs t) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) df

| t_app : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 d1 t2 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) df ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T1 d1 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (df) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1 ⊔ local_locs t2) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tapp t1 t2) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_app_fresh : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 d1 t2 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TFun (q_trans_tenv Γ df ⋒ q_trans_tenv Γ d1) d2 T1 T2) df ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T1 d1 ->
    (♦∈ d1 -> not_free 1 T2) ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (df) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1 ⊔ local_locs t2) (d2) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1) ((q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df)) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tapp t1 t2) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_loc : forall Γ φ Σ l o T q,
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    sindexr l o Σ = Some (T,q) ->
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
    &!l ⊑↑ φ ->
    ♦∉ q ->

    has_type Γ φ Σ &(l,o) (TRef q T) (&!l)

| t_ref: forall Γ φ Σ T t d1,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t T d1 ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tref t) (TRef d1 T) ({♦})

| t_refat : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 t2 T d T1 d1 d2,
    has_type Γ φd Σ t1 T d ->
    ♦∉ d ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (t2) (TRef d1 T1) (d2) ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t2)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (trefat t1 t2) (TRef (d) T) (d2)

| t_deref: forall Γ φ Σ T d d1 t,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t (TRef d1 T) d ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    d1 ⊑↑ φ ->





    kill_sep (local_locs t) d1 ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ !t T d1

| t_assign: forall Γ φ φd Σ T t1 d d1 t2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TRef d1 T) d ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T d1 ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (d) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tassign t1 t2) TUnit ∅

| t_sub: forall Γ φ Σ e T1 d1 T2 d2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ e T1 d1 ->
    stp Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 ->
    d2 ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs e) d2 ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ e T2 d2

| t_withr : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 t2 T1 d1 T2 d2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 T1 d1 ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->



    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T2 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) d2↑ ->
    closed_tm 2 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) t2 ->
    has_type ((bind_tm, false, TRef d1 T1, {♦}) :: (bind_tm, true, TUnit, {♦}) :: Γ)
      (φd ⊔ $!(S (‖Γ‖))) Σ (t2 <~²ᵗ Γ) (T2) (d2) ->
    φd ⊑↑ φ ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1) φd ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (twithr t1 t2) T2 d2


| t_withc : forall Γ φ Σ l t T d,
    l < ‖Σ‖ ->
    has_type Γ (φ) Σ t T d ->
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
    kill_sep &!l d ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (twithc l t) T d
.

Inductive value : tm -> Prop :=
| value_ttabs: forall t, value (ttabs t)
| value_abs : forall t, value (tabs t)
| value_cst : value tunit
| value_loc : forall l o, value &(l, o)
.

Definition store := list (option (list (tm))).

Inductive step : tm -> store -> tm -> store -> Prop :=

| step_ttapp: forall t σ,
  step (ttapp (ttabs t)) σ (t <~ᵗ (ttabs t); tunit) σ
| step_beta : forall t v σ,
    value v ->
    step (tapp (tabs t) v) σ (t <~ᵗ (tabs t); v) σ
| step_ref : forall v σ,
    value v ->
    step (tref v) σ (&‖σ‖) ((Some [v]) :: σ)
| step_refat: forall v l o s σ,
    value v ->
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->

    step (trefat v &(l, o)) σ &(l, ‖s‖) (cinsert σ l (v))
| step_deref : forall σ l o s v,
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->
    indexr o s = Some (v) ->
    step (! &(l, o)) σ v σ
| step_assign : forall σ l o v s,
    l < ‖σ‖ ->
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->
    o < ‖s‖ ->
    value v ->
    step (tassign &(l, o) v) σ tunit (supdate σ l o v)
| step_twithr : forall σ v t,
    value v ->
    step (twithr v t) σ (twithc (‖σ‖) (t <~ᵗ tunit; (&‖σ‖))) ((Some [v]) :: σ)
| step_twithc : forall σ v l,
    value v ->
    step (twithc l v) σ v (update σ l None)

| step_c_tapp: forall t t' σ σ',
  step t σ t' σ' ->
  step (ttapp t)  σ (ttapp t') σ'
| step_c_ref : forall t t' σ σ',
    step t σ t' σ' ->
    step (tref t) σ (tref t') σ'
| step_c_refat_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    value t2 ->
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (trefat t1 t2) σ (trefat t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_refat_r : forall t1 t2 t2' σ σ',
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (trefat t1 t2) σ (trefat t1 t2') σ'
| step_c_deref : forall t t' σ σ',
    step t σ t' σ' ->
    step !t σ !t' σ'
| step_c_app_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (tapp t1 t2) σ (tapp t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_app_r : forall v t2 t2' σ σ',
    value v ->
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (tapp v t2) σ (tapp v t2') σ'
| step_c_assign_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (tassign t1 t2) σ (tassign t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_assign_r : forall v t2 t2' σ σ',
    value v ->
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (tassign v t2) σ (tassign v t2') σ'
| step_c_twithr_l : forall t1 t2 t1' σ σ',
  step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
  step (twithr t1 t2) σ (twithr t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_twithc : forall l t t' σ σ',
  step t σ t' σ' ->
  step (twithc l t) σ (twithc l t') σ'
.

Definition relation (X : Type)(Y: Type) := X -> Y -> X ->  Y -> Prop.

Definition deterministic {X : Type}{Y: Type} (R : relation X Y) :=
  forall (x x1 x2 : X) (y y1 y2: Y), R x y x1 y1 -> R x y x2 y2 -> x1 = x2 /\ y1 = y2.

Local Open Scope splicing.

Local Open Scope substitutions.

Inductive Substq : tenv -> senv -> qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| SExact : forall Γ Σ df,    ♦∉ df -> Substq Γ Σ df df
| SGrow  : forall Γ Σ df dx,
    ♦∉ dx ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) df ↑ ->
    Substq Γ Σ (q_trans_tenv Γ df ⋒ q_trans_tenv Γ dx) dx
.

Definition tph := tunit.

Definition root' (c : option (list tm)) : (option tm) :=
  match c with
  | None => None
  | Some (s) => match indexr 0 s with
                | None => Some tph
                | Some x => Some x
                end
  end.

Definition squish' (σ : store) : list (option tm) := map (root') σ.

Definition indexr' {X : Type} (n : nat) (l : option (list X)) : option X :=
  match l with
    | None => None
    | Some c => indexr n c
  end.

Fixpoint sindexr' {X : Type} (l : loc) (o : offset) (σ : list (option (list X))) : option X :=
  match σ with
    | [] => None
    | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then indexr' o a else sindexr' l o σ'
  end.

Notation "& ( l , o )" := (tloc l o) (at level 0, right associativity).

Notation "& l"   := (tloc l 0) (at level 0, right associativity).

Notation "! t"   := (tderef t) (at level 0, right associativity).

Coercion tvar : var >-> tm.

Coercion TVar : var >-> ty.

Inductive binding :=
| bind_tm : binding
| bind_ty : binding
.

Definition extends {A} (l1 l2 : list A): Prop := exists l', l1 = l' ++ l2.

Notation "x ⊇ y" := (extends x y) (at level 75).

Notation "‖ x ‖" := (length x) (at level 10).

Fixpoint open_rec_tm (k : nat) (u : tm) (t : tm) {struct t} : tm :=
  match t with
  | ttabs   t => ttabs   (open_rec_tm (S (S k)) u t)
  | ttapp t   => ttapp (open_rec_tm k u t)
  | tunit            => tunit
  | tvar   (varF x) => tvar (varF x)
  | tvar   (varB x) => if Nat.eqb k x then u else tvar (varB x)
  | tabs    t       => tabs    (open_rec_tm (S (S k)) u t)
  | tapp    t1 t2   => tapp    (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm k u t2)
  | tloc l o        => tloc l o
  | tref    t       => tref    (open_rec_tm k u t)
  | trefat t1 t2    => trefat (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm k u t2)
  | tderef  t       => tderef  (open_rec_tm k u t)
  | tassign t1 t2   => tassign (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm k u t2)
  | twithr t1 t2    => twithr (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm (S (S k)) u t2)
  | twithc l t      => twithc l (open_rec_tm k u t)
  end
.

Definition open_tm (u u' t : tm) := open_rec_tm 1 u' (open_rec_tm 0 u t).

Definition open_tm' {A : Type} (env : list A) t := open_rec_tm 1 $(S (‖ env ‖)) (open_rec_tm 0 ($‖env‖) t).

Definition openq (u u' q : qual) : qual := open_qual 1 u' (open_qual 0 u q).

Definition openq' {A} (env : list A) q  := openq ($!‖env‖) $!(S (‖env‖)) q.

Fixpoint open_rec_ty (k : nat)(U:  ty) (d' : qual) (T : ty) : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop              => TTop
  | TVar (varF x)     => TVar (varF x)
  | TVar (varB x)     => if Nat.eqb k x then U else (TVar (varB x))
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2  => TAll (open_qual k d' d1) (open_qual (S (S k)) d' d2) (open_rec_ty k U d' T1) (open_rec_ty (S (S k)) U d' T2)
  | TUnit             => TUnit
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2  => TFun (open_qual k d' d1) (open_qual (S (S k)) d' d2) (open_rec_ty k U d' T1) (open_rec_ty (S (S k)) U d' T2)
  | TRef d T          => TRef (open_qual k d' d) (open_rec_ty k U d' T)
  end.

Definition open_ty (U : ty)(du : qual)(V : ty)(dv : qual) (T : ty) : ty := (open_rec_ty 1 V dv  (open_rec_ty 0 U du T)).

Definition open_ty' {A : Type} (env : list A) (T : ty) :=
  open_ty  (TVar $(‖env‖)) ($!‖env‖) (TVar $(S (‖env‖))) ($!( S (‖env‖))) T.

Module OpeningNotations.

Declare Scope opening.

Notation "[[ k ~> u ]]ᵗ t"       := (open_rec_tm k u t) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "[[ k ~> U ~ d ]]ᵀ T"   := (open_rec_ty k U d T) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "[[ k ~> q' ]]ᵈ q"      := (open_qual k q' q) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "t <~ᵗ q ; q'"          := (open_tm q q' t) (at level 10, q at next level) : opening.

Notation "T <~ᵀ U ~ du ; V ~ dv" := (open_ty U du V dv  T) (at level 10, U, du at next level) : opening.

Notation "q <~ᵈ q' ; q''"        := (openq q' q'' q) (at level 10, q' at next level) : opening.

Notation "t <~²ᵗ g"              := (open_tm' g t) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "T <~²ᵀ g"              := (open_ty' g T) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "q <~²ᵈ g"              := (openq' g q) (at level 10) : opening.

End OpeningNotations.

Import OpeningNotations.

Local Open Scope opening.

Fixpoint ty_size (T : ty) : nat :=
  match T with
  | TTop            => 0
  | TVar _          => 0
  | TAll _ _ T1 T2  => S (ty_size T1 + ty_size T2)
  | TUnit           => 0
  | TFun  _ _ T1 T2 => S (ty_size T1 + ty_size T2)
  | TRef  _ T       => S (ty_size T)
  end.

Fixpoint splice (n : nat) (t : tm) {struct t} : tm :=
  match t with
  | ttabs   t  => ttabs (splice n t)
  | ttapp t    => ttapp (splice n t)
  | tunit          => tunit
  | tvar (varF i)  =>
    if le_lt_dec n i then tvar (varF (S i))
    else tvar (varF i)
  | tvar (varB i)  => tvar    (varB i)
  | tabs    t      => tabs    (splice n t)
  | tapp    t1 t2  => tapp    (splice n t1) (splice n t2)
  | tloc l o       => tloc    l o
  | tref    t      => tref    (splice n t)
  | trefat t1 t2   => trefat (splice n t1) (splice n t2)
  | tderef  t      => tderef  (splice n t)
  | tassign t1 t2  => tassign (splice n t1) (splice n t2)
  | twithr t1 t2   => twithr (splice n t1) (splice n t2)
  | twithc l t     => twithc l (splice n t)
  end.

Fixpoint splice_ty (n : nat) (T : ty) {struct T} : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop             => TTop
  | TVar (varF i)    => if le_lt_dec n i then TVar (varF (S i)) else TVar (varF i)
  | TVar (varB i)    => TVar (varB i)
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => TAll (splice_qual n d1) (splice_qual n d2) (splice_ty n T1) (splice_ty n T2)
  | TUnit            => TUnit
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => TFun (splice_qual n d1) (splice_qual n d2) (splice_ty n T1) (splice_ty n T2)
  | TRef d1 T        => TRef (splice_qual n d1) (splice_ty n T)
  end.

Fixpoint unsplice_ty (n : nat) (T : ty) {struct T} : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop             => TTop
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => TFun (unsplice_qual n d1) (unsplice_qual n d2) (unsplice_ty n T1) (unsplice_ty n T2)
  | TRef d1 T        => TRef (unsplice_qual n d1) (unsplice_ty n T)
  end.

Inductive closed_tm: nat  -> nat  -> nat  -> tm -> Prop :=
| cl_ttabs: forall b f l t,
  closed_tm (S (S b)) f l t ->
  closed_tm b f l (ttabs t)
| cl_ttapp: forall b f l t,
  closed_tm b f l t ->
  closed_tm b f l (ttapp t)
| cl_tsct : forall b f l,
    closed_tm b f l tunit
| cl_tvarb: forall b f l x,
    x < b ->
    closed_tm b f l #x
| cl_tvarf: forall b f l x,
    x < f ->
    closed_tm b f l $x
| cl_tabs:  forall b f l tm,
    closed_tm (S (S b)) f l tm ->
    closed_tm b f l (tabs tm)
| cl_tapp:  forall b f l tm1 tm2,
    closed_tm b f l tm1 ->
    closed_tm b f l tm2 ->
    closed_tm b f l (tapp tm1 tm2)
| cl_tloc: forall b f l l' o',
    l' < l ->
    closed_tm b f l &(l', o')
| cl_tref:  forall b f l tm,
    closed_tm b f l tm ->
    closed_tm b f l (tref tm)
| cl_trefat: forall b f l tm1 tm2,
    closed_tm b f l tm1 ->
    closed_tm b f l tm2 ->
    closed_tm b f l (trefat tm1 tm2)
| cl_tderef:  forall b f l tm,
    closed_tm b f l tm ->
    closed_tm b f l (tderef tm)
| cl_tassign:  forall b f l tm1 tm2,
    closed_tm b f l tm1 ->
    closed_tm b f l tm2 ->
    closed_tm b f l (tassign tm1 tm2)
| cl_twithr: forall b f l tm1 tm2,
    closed_tm b f l tm1 ->
    closed_tm (S (S b)) f l tm2 ->
    closed_tm b f l (twithr tm1 tm2)
| cl_twithc: forall b f l l' t,
    l' < l ->
    closed_tm b f l t ->
    closed_tm b f l (twithc l' t)
.

Inductive closed_ty : nat  -> nat  -> nat  -> ty -> Prop :=
| cl_TTop : forall b f l,
  closed_ty b  f l TTop
| cl_ttvarf: forall b f l x,
  x < f ->
  closed_ty b f l (TVar (varF x))
| cl_ttvarb: forall b f l x,
  x < b ->
  closed_ty b f l (TVar (varB x))
|  cl_TAll:  forall b f l d1 d2 T1 T2 ,
  closed_Qual b f l d1 ↑ ->
  closed_Qual  (S (S b)) f l d2 ↑ ->
  closed_ty b f l T1 ->
  closed_ty (S (S b)) f l T2 ->
  closed_ty b f l (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2)
| cl_TUnit : forall b f l,
    closed_ty b f l TUnit
| cl_TRef : forall b f l T q,
    closed_ty b f l T ->
    closed_Qual b f l q ↑ ->
    closed_ty b f l (TRef q T)
| cl_TFun : forall b f l d1 d2 T1 T2,
    closed_Qual b f l d1 ↑ ->
    closed_Qual (S (S b)) f l d2 ↑ ->
    closed_ty b f l T1 ->
    closed_ty (S (S b)) f l T2 ->
    closed_ty b f l (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint tfvs (T : ty) (n : nat) {struct T} : bool :=
  match T with
  | TVar (varF i)    => i =? n
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => qfvs d1 n || qfvs d2 n || tfvs T1 n || tfvs T2 n
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => qfvs d1 n || qfvs d2 n || tfvs T1 n || tfvs T2 n
  | TRef d1 T        => qfvs d1 n || tfvs T n
  | _                => false
  end.

Fixpoint Tfvs (T : ty) (n : nat) {struct T} : Prop :=
  match T with
  | TVar (varF i)    => i = n
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => qfvs d1↑ n \/ qfvs d2↑ n \/ Tfvs T1 n \/ Tfvs T2 n
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => qfvs d1↑ n \/ qfvs d2↑ n \/ Tfvs T1 n \/ Tfvs T2 n
  | TRef d1 T        => qfvs d1↑ n \/ Tfvs T n
  | _                => False
  end.

Fixpoint tbvs (T : ty) (n : nat) {struct T} : bool :=
  match T with
  | TVar (varF i)    => i =? n
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => qbvs d1 n || qbvs d2 (S (S n)) || tbvs T1 n || tbvs T2 (S (S n))
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => qbvs d1 n || qbvs d2 (S (S n)) || tbvs T1 n || tbvs T2 (S (S n))
  | TRef d1 T        => qbvs d1 n || tbvs T n
  | _                => false
  end.

Fixpoint Tbvs (T : ty) (n : nat) {struct T} : Prop :=
  match T with
  | TVar (varF i)    => i = n
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => qbvs d1↑ n \/ qbvs d2↑ (S (S n)) \/ Tbvs T1 n \/ Tbvs T2 (S (S n))
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => qbvs d1↑ n \/ qbvs d2↑ (S (S n)) \/ Tbvs T1 n \/ Tbvs T2 (S (S n))
                                                       (fun x => (qfresh d1 -> N_or (qbvs d1) (qbvs d2) x)   /\ (~ (qfresh d1) -> qbvs d1 x)),
                                                       (fun x => (qfresh d1 -> N_or (qlocs d1) (qlocs d2) x) /\ (~ (qfresh d1) -> qlocs d1 x))).

Definition Qdiff (d1 d2 : Qual) : Qual := (qfresh d1 /\ ((qfresh d2) -> False), N_diff (qfvs d1) (qfvs d2), N_diff (qbvs d1) (qbvs d2), N_diff (qlocs d1) (qlocs d2)).

Definition Qdom {A} (Σ : list A): Qual := (True, N_empty, N_empty, (N_dom Σ)).

Definition q_empty: qual := (false, n_empty, n_empty, n_empty).

Definition Q_empty: Qual := (False, N_empty, N_empty, N_empty).

Definition Q_lift (q: qual): Qual := (Is_true (qfresh q), N_lift (qfvs q), N_lift (qbvs q), N_lift (qlocs q)).

Definition open_qual (k : nat) (d' : qual) (d : qual) : qual :=
  if (qbvs d k) then
  qor (qfresh d, qfvs d, n_diff (qbvs d) (n_one k), qlocs d) d'
  else d
.

Definition open_Qual (k : nat) (d' : Qual) (d : Qual) : Qual :=
  (
  (qbvs d k -> qfresh d \/ qfresh d') /\ (~(qbvs d k) -> qfresh d),
  fun x => (qbvs d k -> (N_or (qfvs d) (qfvs d') x)) /\ (~(qbvs d k) -> qfvs d x),
  fun x => (qbvs d k -> (N_or (N_diff (qbvs d) (N_one k)) (qbvs d') x)) /\ (~(qbvs d k) -> qbvs d x),
  fun x => (qbvs d k -> (N_or (qlocs d) (qlocs d') x)) /\ (~(qbvs d k) -> qlocs d x)
  )
.

Definition splice_qual (n : nat) (d : qual) : qual :=
  (qfresh d,(n_splice n (qfvs d)),qbvs d,qlocs d)
.

Definition splice_Qual (n : nat) (d : Qual) : Qual :=
  (qfresh d,(N_splice n (qfvs d)),qbvs d,qlocs d)
.

Definition unsplice_qual (n : nat) (d : qual) : qual :=
  (qfresh d,(n_unsplice n (qfvs d)),qbvs d,qlocs d)
.

Definition unsplice_Qual (n : nat) (d : Qual) : Qual :=
  (qfresh d,(N_unsplice n (qfvs d)),qbvs d,qlocs d)
.

Definition subst_qual (q : qual) (v : nat) (q' : qual) : qual :=
  if qfvs q v
  then qor (qfresh q, n_unsplice 0 (n_diff (qfvs q) (n_one v)), qbvs q, qlocs q) q'

.

Definition subst_Qual (q : Qual) (v : nat) (q' : Qual) : Qual :=
  (
  (qfvs q v -> qfresh q \/ qfresh q') /\ (~(qfvs q v) -> qfresh q),
  fun x => (qfvs q v -> (N_or (N_unsplice 0 (N_diff (qfvs q) (N_one v))) (qfvs q') x)) /\ (~(qfvs q v) -> N_unsplice 0 (qfvs q) x),
  fun x => (qfvs q v -> (N_or (qbvs q) (qbvs q') x)) /\ (~(qfvs q v) -> qbvs q x),
  fun x => (qfvs q v -> (N_or (qlocs q) (qlocs q') x)) /\ (~(qfvs q v) -> qlocs q x)
  )
.

Definition closed_qual b f l (q : qual) :=
  closed_nats f (qfvs q) /\ closed_nats b (qbvs q) /\ closed_nats l (qlocs q).

Definition closed_Qual b f l (q : Qual) :=
  closed_Nats f (qfvs q) /\ closed_Nats b (qbvs q) /\ closed_Nats l (qlocs q).

Module QualNotations.

Declare Scope qualifiers.

Notation "∅"        := (q_empty) (at level 9) : qualifiers.

Notation "{♦}"      := (true, n_empty, n_empty, n_empty) (at level 9) : qualifiers.

Notation "∅{ f }"   := (f, n_empty, n_empty, n_empty)  (at level 9) : qualifiers.

Notation "l ∈ₗ d"   := (qmem (inr l) d) (at level 75) : qualifiers.

Notation "v ∈ᵥ d"   := (qmem (inl v) d) (at level 75) : qualifiers.

Notation "l ∈?ₗ d"  := (qmemb (inr l) d) (at level 75) : qualifiers.

s=p.read_text()
i=s.index('Theorem type_safety')
p.write_text(s[:i]+'''Local Lemma safety_q_closed_weaken b b' f f' L q :
  b <= b' -> f <= f' -> closed_Qual b f L q↑ -> closed_Qual b' f' L q↑.
Proof.
  intros Hb Hf (HF & HB & HL). refine (conj _ (conj _ HL)).
  - intros x Hx. specialize (HF x Hx). lia.
  - intros x Hx. specialize (HB x Hx). lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_ty_vars_weaken b b' f f' L T :
  closed_ty b f L T -> b <= b' -> f <= f' -> closed_ty b' f' L T.
Proof.
  intros H. revert b' f'. induction H; intros b' f' HB HF;
    constructor; eauto using safety_q_closed_weaken; try lia.
  all: try (eapply safety_q_closed_weaken; [lia|exact HF|eassumption]).
  all: eauto with arith.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_q_open_skip q b f L k a :
  closed_Qual b f L q↑ -> b <= k -> open_qual k a q = q.
Proof.
  intros (_ & HB & _) Hk. unfold open_qual.
  destruct (qbvs q k) eqn:H; [|reflexivity].
  specialize (HB k H). lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_ty_open_skip T b f L k U a :
  closed_ty b f L T -> b <= k -> open_rec_ty k U a T = T.
Proof.
  intros H. revert k. induction H; intros k Hk; simpl;
    try reflexivity; try (f_equal; eauto using safety_q_open_skip; eauto with arith).
  - replace (k =? x) with false by (symmetry; apply Nat.eqb_neq; lia).
    reflexivity.
  - f_equal.
    + eapply safety_q_open_skip; eassumption.
    + eapply safety_q_open_skip; [eassumption|lia].
    + eauto.
    + apply IHclosed_ty2. lia.
  - f_equal.
    + eapply safety_q_open_skip; eassumption.
    + eapply safety_q_open_skip; [eassumption|lia].
    + eauto.
    + apply IHclosed_ty2. lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_q_open_named k b f F L q a :
  closed_Qual b f L q↑ ->
  closed_Qual 0 F L a↑ ->
  f <= F ->
  closed_Qual b F L (open_qual k a q)↑ /\\\\ qbvs (open_qual k a q) k = false.
Proof.
  intros Hq Ha Hf.
  unfold open_qual. destruct (qbvs q k) eqn:Htest.
  - assert (Hr : closed_Qual b F L
      (qfresh q, qfvs q, n_diff (qbvs q) (n_one k), qlocs q)↑).
    { destruct Hq as (HF & HB & HL).
      refine (conj _ (conj _ HL)).
      - intros x Hx. specialize (HF x Hx). lia.
      - intros x Hx. apply andb_true_iff in Hx as [Hx _]. now apply HB. }
    split.
    + apply safety_qual_join_closed; [exact Hr|eauto using safety_q_closed_weaken, Nat.le_0_l].
    + change ((qbvs q k && negb (k =? k)) || qbvs a k = false).
      destruct Ha as (_ & HB & _).
      destruct (qbvs a k) eqn:H; [specialize (HB k H); lia|].
      now rewrite Nat.eqb_refl, Htest.
  - split; [eauto using safety_fv_closed_weaken|reflexivity].
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_q_open_two k f F L q a b :
  closed_Qual (S (S k)) f L q↑ -> f <= F ->
  closed_Qual 0 F L a↑ -> closed_Qual 0 F L b↑ ->
  closed_Qual k F L (open_qual (S k) b (open_qual k a q))↑.
Proof.
  intros Hq Hf Ha Hb.
  destruct (safety_q_open_named k _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq Ha Hf) as (Hqa & Hk).
  destruct (safety_q_open_named (S k) _ _ _ _ _ _ Hqa Hb (Nat.le_refl F)) as
    ((HF & HB & HL) & HS).
  refine (conj HF (conj _ HL)).
  intros x Hx.
  pose proof (HB x Hx) as Hlt.
  assert (Hneq : x <> S k) by congruence.
  assert (Hx' : x <> k).
  { intros ->. unfold open_qual at 1 in Hx.
    destruct (qbvs (open_qual k a q) (S k)).
    - change ((qbvs (open_qual k a q) k && negb (k =? S k)) || qbvs b k = true) in Hx.
      rewrite Hk in Hx. destruct Hb as (_ & Hb & _).
      specialize (Hb k Hx). lia.
    - congruence. }
  lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_ty_open_two T k f F L U V a b :
  closed_ty (S (S k)) f L T -> f <= F ->
  closed_ty 0 F L U -> closed_ty 0 F L V ->
  closed_Qual 0 F L a↑ -> closed_Qual 0 F L b↑ ->
  closed_ty k F L (open_rec_ty (S k) V b (open_rec_ty k U a T)).
Proof.
  revert k. induction T; intros k HC Hle HU HV Ha Hb; inversion HC; subst; simpl;
    try solve [constructor; eauto using safety_q_open_two].
  - constructor. lia.
  - destruct (k =? x) eqn:Hx.
    + rewrite (safety_ty_open_skip _ _ _ _ _ V b HU) by lia.
      eauto using safety_ty_vars_weaken, Nat.le_0_l, Nat.le_refl.
    + simpl. destruct (S k =? x) eqn:Hy.
      * eauto using safety_ty_vars_weaken, Nat.le_0_l, Nat.le_refl.
      * apply Nat.eqb_neq in Hx, Hy. constructor. lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_ty_size_open_name T k x q :
  ty_size (open_rec_ty k (TVar (varF x)) q T) = ty_size T.
Proof.
  revert k. induction T; intros k; simpl; try reflexivity;
    try (rewrite ?IHT1, ?IHT2, ?IHT; reflexivity).
  destruct v; simpl; [reflexivity|]. destruct (k =? i); reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma safety_stp_refl Γ Σ T d e :
  closed_ty 0 (length Γ) (length Σ) T -> qstp Γ Σ d e -> stp Γ Σ T d T e.
Proof.
  remember (ty_size T) as n eqn:Hn.
  revert Γ T d e Hn.
  induction n using lt_wf_ind.
  intros Γ T d e Hn Hcl HQ. destruct T; inversion Hcl; subst; simpl in *.
  - now apply s_top.
  - destruct (safety_indexr_exists _ _ H0) as [entry Hentry].
    eapply s_tvar_refl; eassumption.
  - apply s_all; try assumption.
    + eapply H; [|reflexivity|eassumption|]; [lia|].
      apply qs_sq; [apply safety_subq_refl|assumption].
    + eapply H; [|reflexivity| |].
      * unfold open_ty', open_ty. rewrite "'!safety_ty_size_open_name. lia.
      * unfold open_ty'"', open_ty. eapply safety_ty_open_two; simpl;
          eauto using safety_fv_closed, cl_ttvarf; lia.
      * apply qs_sq; [apply safety_subq_refl|].
        unfold openq', openq. eapply safety_q_open_two; simpl;
          eauto using safety_fv_closed; lia.
  - now apply s_base.
  - apply s_fun; try assumption.
    + eapply H; [|reflexivity|eassumption|]; [lia|].
      apply qs_sq; [apply safety_subq_refl|assumption].
    + eapply H; [|reflexivity| |].
      * unfold open_ty', open_ty. rewrite "'!safety_ty_size_open_name. lia.
      * unfold open_ty'"', open_ty. eapply safety_ty_open_two; simpl;
          eauto using safety_fv_closed, cl_ttvarf; lia.
      * apply qs_sq; [apply safety_subq_refl|].
        unfold openq', openq. eapply safety_q_open_two; simpl;
          eauto using safety_fv_closed; lia.
  - apply s_ref; try assumption;
      try solve [eapply H; [|reflexivity|eassumption|]; [lia|];
        apply qs_sq; [apply safety_subq_refl|apply safety_qual_const_closed]].
    all: apply qs_sq; [apply safety_subq_refl|assumption].
Qed.

  preserve [] Σ ϰ φ (local_locs t) t' (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) df σ' ->
  preserve [] Σ ϰ φ (local_locs (ttapp t)) (ttapp t')
    (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1) σ'.
Proof.
  intros HC Hσ HW HR HT HT1 HC1 HB Hnf Hlive Hfree HS1 HS2 HP.
  destruct (safety_preserve_unpack _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HP)
    as (Σ' & δ & φ' & ϰ' & HE & HU & Hδ & HF & HC' & HD & HT' & Hσ' & HW' & Hsepδ).

  pose proof (safety_senv_length _ _ HE) as Hle.
  assert (HC2 : closed_Qual 2 0 (length Σ) d2↑).
  { pose proof (safety_typing_type_closed _ _ _ _ _ _ HT) as Hcl.

    by (eapply t_tapp; eassumption).

  - eauto using safety_disjointq_old.
  - eapply safety_cast_in_step with (t := ttapp t) (σ := σ)
        (d' := d2 <~ᵈ (df ⋓ δ) ; d1); try eassumption.
    + now apply step_c_tapp.
    + eapply t_tapp; [exact HT'| | | |exact Hnf| |exact Hfree| |].
      * eauto using safety_ty_closed_weaken.
      * eauto using safety_locs_closed_weaken.
      * exact (safety_update_scope_fresh _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU Hφ HSB HB).
      * exact (safety_update_scope_sub _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU Hφ HS1 Hlive).
      * exact (safety_step_carries_sep _ _ _ _ _ _ HL HR HW Hσ HC1 HS1).
      * exact (safety_step_carries_sep_general _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HL HR HW Hσ HC2 HS2).
    + apply safety_openq_plus_fun.
      eapply safety_q_has_no_bvar.
      eapply safety_qual_closed_of_sub; [exact Hδ|].
      apply safety_dom_closed. exact (safety_ctx_scope _ _ _ _ HC').

Local Lemma safety_type_safety_from_substitution :
  safety_value_storage -> safety_beta_substitution -> safety_arena_substitution ->
  forall {Σ ϰ t T d φ},

    value t \/ (forall {σ}, CtxOK [] φ Σ ϰ σ -> wf_store σ ->

  (qfresh q, arena_shift_bits n (qfvs q), qbvs q, qlocs q).

  qfresh q = qfresh p /\\
  (forall x, qfvs q x = arena_shift_bits n (qfvs p) x) /\\
  (forall x, qbvs q x = qbvs p x) /\\
  (forall x, qlocs q x = qlocs p x).

Local Lemma arena_shift_qual_spec n q :
  arena_qual_shifted n q (arena_shift_qual n q).
Proof. repeat split; reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma arena_shift_qual_rigid n b L q :
  closed_Qual b 0 L q↑ -> arena_qual_shifted n q q.
Proof.
  intros (Hf & _ & _). repeat split; try reflexivity.
  intro x. unfold arena_shift_bits.
  assert (H : forall i, qfvs q i = false).
  { intro i. destruct (qfvs q i) eqn:Hi; [specialize (Hf i Hi); lia|reflexivity]. }
  rewrite (H x). destruct (x <? n); [reflexivity|now rewrite H].
Qed.

Local Lemma arena_shift_qual_le n p p' q q' :
  arena_qual_shifted n p p' -> arena_qual_shifted n q q' ->
  p ⊑↑ q -> p' ⊑↑ q'.
Proof.
  intros (Hp & Hpf & Hpb & Hpl) (Hq & Hqf & Hqb & Hql) H.
  apply safety_qual_le in H as (H & Hf & Hb & Hl).

  - now rewrite Hp, Hq.
  - intros x. rewrite Hpf, Hqf. unfold arena_shift_bits.

  - intros x. rewrite Hpb, Hqb. apply Hb.
  - intros x. rewrite Hpl, Hql. apply Hl.
Qed.

    try solve [constructor; eauto using arena_shift_open_qual].

  intros (Hlen & Hget) HT HQ. split; [simpl; lia|].
  intros x k0 b0 U p HI. simpl in HI.
  destruct (x =? length Γ) eqn:Hx.
  - apply Nat.eqb_eq in Hx. subst x. inversion HI; subst.

  | tref t        => tref (subst_tm t v u)
  | trefat t1 t2  => trefat (subst_tm t1 v u) (subst_tm t2 v u)
  | ! t           => ! (subst_tm t v u)
  | tassign t1 t2 => tassign (subst_tm t1 v u) (subst_tm t2 v u)
  | twithr t1 t2  => twithr (subst_tm t1 v u) (subst_tm t2 v u)
  | twithc l t    => twithc l (subst_tm t v u)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_ty (T : ty) (v : nat) (U: ty) (q : qual) : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop             => TTop
  | TVar (varF i)    => if Nat.eqb i v then U else (TVar (varF (pred i)))
  | TVar (varB i)    => TVar (varB i)
  | TAll q1 q2 T1 T2 => TAll (subst_qual q1 v q) (subst_qual q2 v q) (subst_ty T1 v U q) (subst_ty T2 v U q)
  | TUnit            => TUnit
  | TFun q1 q2 T1 T2 => TFun (subst_qual q1 v q) (subst_qual q2 v q) (subst_ty T1 v U q) (subst_ty T2 v U q)
  | TRef q1 T        => TRef (subst_qual q1 v q) (subst_ty T v U q)
  end.

Class substitutable_env {p : Type} `{@qenv p}: Type := {

  env_subst : nat -> ty -> qual -> p -> p;
}.

Definition subst_tenv_elmt := (fun n T' q' (X : (binding * bool * ty * qual)) =>
  match X with
  | (bd, b, T, q) => (bd, b, subst_ty T n T' q', subst_qual q n q')
  end).

Definition subst_senv_elmt := (fun n T' q' (X : (ty * qual)) =>
  match X with
  | (T, q) => (subst_ty T n T' q', subst_qual q n q')
  end).

#[export] Instance tenv_substitutable : @substitutable_env (binding * bool * ty * qual) tenv_qenv := {
  env_subst := subst_tenv_elmt;
}.

#[export] Instance senv_substitutable : @substitutable_env (ty * qual) senv_qenv := {
  env_subst := subst_senv_elmt;
}.

Definition subst_env {p : Type} `{substitutable_env p} (n : nat) (T' : ty) (q' : qual)  (E : env p): env p := map (env_subst n T' q') E.

Definition subst_tenv (Γ : tenv) (v : nat) (U: ty)(q1 : qual) : tenv := subst_env v U q1 Γ.

Definition subst_senv (Σ : senv) (v : nat) (U: ty)(q1 : qual) : senv := map (subst_env v U q1) Σ.
